stories.title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
stories.summary: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing.

stories.title: Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds

An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time.
